sections.content:
A pending payment authorization may appear before an order is dispatched. A pending authorization is not necessarily a settled charge and may be released or adjusted according to the payment provider's process. The final captured amount is shown in the order receipt and can include taxes, shipping, discounts, and approved adjustments.

Customers should compare the order confirmation and payment statement before reporting a discrepancy. If a duplicate or unfamiliar settled charge appears, contact support through the verified Help Center and provide the order reference; never send full card details or security codes.

The assistant must not infer payment success from a customer message or a pending bank notification. Payment state must come from the authorized order/payment record. The demo project does not process real payments, so seeded payment states must be clearly identified as simulated.
